turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: no metric counts customers by how many orders each placed, and I did not compute one myself. The closest metrics are active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order), repeat customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all) and orders (all orders placed, cancelled included).
